lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured grid of high-luminance circular spots is visible posterior to the gills. The pattern consists of approximately 4-5 distinct spots per vertical column, regularly spaced across the lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity align with the vertical columns of spots, creating a grid-like configuration where the spots serve as anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges (carinae) are visible across the upper and mid-flank, exhibiting a sharp light-to-shadow gradient from top to bottom.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible portion of the first dorsal fin displays approximately 5-6 high-intensity spots distributed primarily along the posterior half and base of the fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: A remora is attached to the ventral region, positioned below the primary lateral spot pattern.
